data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘bealen’ meaning ‘to bend’ or ‘to build’. The name could be a reference to a strong, sturdy, and resilient individual who is able to bend or adapt to circumstances. Parents who choose Bently usually hope their child will grow to embody bent, curved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
